findings.title: Artillery hits residential area near Al-Qastal Towers, killing three and injuring at least ten
findings.location: Al-Qastal Towers vicinity, east Deir al-Balah, central Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Three people killed, including a child and woman; ten or more injured and transferred for hospital care
findings.summary: WAFA's correspondent reports Israeli artillery shelling near the Al-Qastal Towers residential complex killing three Palestinians, including a woman and a child, and injuring about 20. Anadolu separately reports three killed and at least ten injured in the same attack, citing an Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital medical source and witnesses. WAFA's story introduction inconsistently states six deaths across Friday attacks; the incident-specific count is three. Treat wound count as at least ten and exact total unconfirmed.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: claiming the lives of three Palestinians, including a child and a woman
findings.source_type: Palestinian news agency on-scene report, corroborated by Anadolu medical-source reporting

bounded_discovery_context.source_total_fatality_count_conflict: WAFA article lead says six across incidents; incident-specific count three

findings.title: Nasser Hospital strike fatality count reportedly rises to seven after wounded man dies
findings.location: Nasser Medical Complex, Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Fatalities from November 12 hospital strike, including 20-year-old Eyad Mohammed al-Jazzar

findings.title: UN Human Rights Office warns of unexploded ordnance remaining from Nasser Hospital strike
findings.publisher: Anadolu Agency reporting UN Human Rights Office in Palestine statement
findings.location: Nasser Medical Complex, Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Hospital patients, staff and civilians exposed to potentially unexploded munitions
findings.summary: Anadolu quotes a November 13 UN Human Rights Office in Palestine statement reporting three missiles were used in the hospital strike, but only one detonated. The office warned the remaining unexploded ordnance posed an added danger. This adds a distinct safety and functioning-capacity consequence of the already recorded November 12 hospital strike; the original UN statement was not directly retrieved.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Three missiles were used in the attack, but only one detonated
findings.source_type: Established wire reporting attributing operational detail to UN Human Rights Office

findings.title: Nine-month-old infant dies from hypothermia in al-Mawasi; first reported cold-related death this winter
findings.location: Al-Mawasi, Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip; transferred from Kuwaiti Hospital to Nasser Medical Complex
findings.affected_population_or_system: Displaced infants and families exposed to freezing conditions and shortage of heated shelter; nine-month-old Kinan Ahmad Arqiq
findings.summary: WAFA reports medical sources and forensic medicine attributing the death of nine-month-old Kinan Ahmad Arqiq to a severe drop in body temperature. The infant arrived at Nasser Medical Complex already dead on November 12, after transfer from Kuwaiti Hospital. Article published at 04:45 PST, outside this run's publication window, but no prior watch heartbeat inspected recorded this specific fatality; logged as bounded late-discovery recall rather than an incident arising during the current hour.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: nine-month-old Kinan Ahmad Arqiq died due to a severe drop in body temperature
findings.source_type: Palestinian national news agency citing medical sources and forensic assessment

bounded_discovery_context.newly_verified_detail: Previously missed identified hypothermia death associated with November 12 weather impacts
